notes: Lang (right) and Frintz (left) run N-S; Dorsey, Goethe, Mulberry, Peete, East Clifton Av., Hurst Alley and East McMicken Av. run across. Dorsey, Goethe, Mulberry, Peete, Clifton and Hurst continue west off the drawing (x~1100) onto sheet 161. Frintz between Mulberry and Peete and Lang between Mulberry and Peete are 50 ft stairways (steps drawn), so those legs are not streets; Frintz/Mulberry not picked. The N-S 12 ft alley at x~2468 runs Peete -> Clifton -> Hurst -> McMicken: printed ALLEY on the Peete-Clifton leg, and between Clifton and Hurst a vertical italic label that reads SHAAR (reading uncertain; could be a proper name like Schaar); recorded as Shaar Alley throughout. Hurst Alley printed HURST ... ALLEY (split by block number 5); width not printed here. Names printed bare: DORSEY, GOETHE, MULBERRY, PEETE, FRINTZ, LANG, VINE, ELDER; E. CLIFTON AV., E. McMICKEN AV., WALNUT ST., HAMER ST. as printed. South of McMicken the blocks are sheet-155 outlines: Elder (30 ft) runs SSW to Hamer St (Hamer T at Elder, Elder continues SSW to the bottom edge; Hamer runs ESE off the drawing at ~(2120,4300)). Four 12 ft gaps open off McMicken's south side at x~2248, 2573, 2895, 3220 (outline only, ending at y~4107 where the outline stops): the first is taken as Benton Alley (sheet 155), the other three are listed as unnamed alleys (the one at 2895 matches 155's unnamed alley from Back St). Walnut and Lang meet McMicken ~35 px apart (Walnut from the SSE, Lang from the N). Vine crosses the lower-left corner; its west side is Volume 3 (the 'See Volume Three' line is not Vine's face: it lies ~77 ft from the east face). Goethe measures ~53 ft, Dorsey ~31 ft, Mulberry ~71 ft, Peete ~23 ft (printed 22'), McMicken ~61 ft; scale ~3.4 px/ft.
